newsitem.title: USA: New US House tax offer to include aviation package.
newsitem.headline: New US House tax offer to include aviation package.

text.p: House tax negotiators said Thursday they planned to send their Senate counterparts a new offer that would include moves on an aviation tax package.
However it would change one proposal that the Senate had agreed to -- a $15.50 per passenger international arrival and departure fee, House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Bill Archer said.

"We hope to give them in this counteroffer a complete package for the aviation taxes," the Texas Republican told reporters after meeting with House tax conferees. "Our counteroffer will include a complete package that will not include a $15.50 exit and arrival fee," he said.
House and Senate tax negotiators are trying to work out differences in their separate legislation to craft a final tax cut bill.
